exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

effects.bonus_update_timing: immediately as pods deploy or expire

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: requires full setup, that is three active pods

rules.text: Every active pod beyond the first gives all active pods +25% attack rate, capped at +50% with three pods.
The bonus updates immediately as pods deploy or expire.
At full setup this is a direct +50% damage-throughput increase without changing each pod's Damage value.
